reasons: Cited Section 19 supports the compliant classification: 19.1 gives the professional/workmanlike standard plus material conformance, 19.2 gives a 90-day deliverable warranty measured from the later of delivery or acceptance and a full-term conformance warranty for Hosted Services, and 19.3 adds no-malicious-code and Applicable Law compliance — at or above the preferred position.

Remedy in 19.4 (prompt re-performance/repair/replacement at no charge, escalating to termination and refund of Fees paid, expressly non-exclusive for fraud, IP, confidentiality, privacy, security and indemnified claims) satisfies the rule's repair/replace/refund requirement.

Disclaimer in 19.5 is mutual and expressly states no disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity or remedy, so it does not swallow the express warranty and walk-away 'AS IS' territory is not implicated.
Consistent with a compliant finding, no redline was rendered and no counterparty comment was proposed; the paragraphs are unchanged.

The failed deterministic check is a false negative: the period is written as 'ninety days' in words rather than a numeric/month form, which the regex heuristic does not match; substance meets the ≥90-day threshold.
